sources.snippet: MimicGen can produce good quality datasets and policies across different quality human operators. Below, we show MimicGen datasets generated on Square D2 from two sets of source datasets - 10 demos from a better quality operator and 10 demos from a worse quality operator (both are from the robomimic Square MH dataset).
